findings.title: N+1 query pattern in ensureCatalog
findings.description: The ensureCatalog method iterates through definitions and performs individual database queries for each item (findUnique, create, update). With 40+ definitions, this causes 40+ database round trips on every module initialization.
findings.snippet:
for (const definition of this.definitions) {
  const existingItem = await this.prisma.economicDataItem.findUnique({
findings.suggested_issue: Batch load all existing items with findMany, then use createMany/updateMany for bulk operations

findings.title: N+1 query pattern in category association
findings.description: Category associations are created one at a time in a loop for each data item, causing multiple database round trips.
findings.suggested_issue: Use createMany to batch insert category associations

findings.title: Inefficient Map usage in React hook causing re-renders
findings.description: useEconomicData returns a Map object which React cannot shallow compare. Every query response creates a new Map instance, causing unnecessary re-renders of all consuming components.
findings.snippet:
const grouped: EconomicSeriesMap = useMemo(() => {
  const map: EconomicSeriesMap = new Map();
findings.suggested_issue: Convert Map to a plain object for React state, or use a stable reference pattern with useMemo dependencies

findings.title: Repeated sorting in chart components
findings.description: Multiple chart components call getSortedValues which sorts the same data repeatedly. The sorting is O(n log n) and happens on every render.
findings.suggested_issue: Sort data once at the source (useEconomicData hook) and store pre-sorted values

findings.title: Missing database index hint for time-range queries
findings.description: getDataByCategory queries EconomicDataPoint by recordedAt range and category. Without proper indexing, this could cause full table scans on large datasets.
findings.suggested_issue: Ensure composite index exists on (itemId, recordedAt) and consider adding query hints

findings.title: Unbounded data fetch without pagination
findings.description: getDataByCategory fetches all data points in a time range without pagination. For long time ranges with high-frequency data, this could return millions of rows causing memory issues.
findings.suggested_issue: Add pagination with cursor-based navigation, or implement server-side aggregation for large ranges

findings.title: Inline object creation in JSX causing re-renders
findings.description: Multiple components create inline style objects in JSX (e.g., style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}), creating new object references on every render.
findings.suggested_issue: Extract static styles to constants outside component or use CSS classes

findings.title: Synchronous JSON.stringify in hot path
findings.description: metadataEquals uses JSON.stringify for deep comparison on every catalog sync iteration. This is a blocking operation that could slow down module initialization.
findings.suggested_issue: Use a dedicated deep-equal library or implement shallow comparison for known structure

findings.title: No caching for repeated category lookups
findings.description: getDataByCategory performs database queries without caching. Repeated requests for the same category and time range hit the database every time.
findings.snippet: async getDataByCategory(categoryKey: string, start: Date, end: Date, granularity?: string)
findings.suggested_issue: Implement Redis caching with TTL based on data frequency, invalidate on new data ingestion

findings.title: Redundant Array.from conversions
findings.description: getCandlestickSeries uses Array.from(buckets.keys()) followed by sort, creating intermediate arrays unnecessarily.
findings.suggested_issue: Use spread operator [...buckets.keys()] or maintain sorted order during insertion

findings.title: GraphQL resolver loads full item for each point
findings.description: The getDataByCategory query includes item relation for every data point. With thousands of points, this creates significant overhead even with Prisma's query optimization.
findings.suggested_issue: Use DataLoader pattern to batch item lookups, or denormalize frequently accessed item fields
